scheme_name: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Self Employment Programme for Transgender
other_conditions: Must secure a loan from a nationalized or cooperative bank
Benefit is available only once per individual
Grant is disbursed only after the business is started and verified by the lending agency
benefits_summary: Provides a grant of up to 25% of the total business cost or ₹50,000 (whichever is lower) for self‑employment, contingent on securing a loan from a nationalized or cooperative bank.
